title: Introduce metrics, usage accounting, installation identity, and stats sink boundaries
description: TASK-040 covers trace/log/status events and TASK-078 covers provider response metadata. AstrBot also has a metrics surface for installation identity, remote metric upload, platform message counts, LLM/TTS stats, token usage persistence, and dashboard stat aggregation. Rust should keep metrics and usage accounting distinct from observability logs, provider parsers, platform adapters, and storage table helpers.

files.change: Expose typed metric events, sinks, usage accounting, and installation identity without coupling to runtime/web.
Represent message ticks, LLM ticks, TTS stats, platform adapter IDs, provider IDs, and timing snapshots.
Bridge provider token usage metadata into conversation/session stats without embedding accounting in providers.
Separate storage-backed platform stats from optional remote metric upload and redaction policy.

criteria: Provider response metadata can feed usage accounting without providers importing storage or dashboard code.
Platform adapters emit metric events instead of writing stats directly.
Remote metric upload is optional and separated from local platform stats persistence.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-metrics && cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
